page_title: RefVid: The Same Product or Character in Every AI Video

sources.entry: RefVid - Generates AI videos from 1–10 reference photos of a character or product, using the photos to help maintain character or product consistency. New accounts get one free 5-second clip, then paid credits or plans. #paid

summary.name: RefVid
summary.one_liner: RefVid is a paid AI video generator that uses 1–10 reference photos of a character or product to keep the same subject consistent across a series of videos.
use_cases: Keep a recurring presenter or mascot the same across short videos
Make product videos with the label intact in different scenes
Test ad variations while the person and product stay fixed
Produce a cartoon or story series with consistent characters
Turn a few photos into a 3–30 second clip with sound
summary.what_it_does: RefVid generates AI videos from one to ten uploaded photos of a character or product, which it uses to hold the face, outfit, logo or label steady from clip to clip. Users write a prompt, choose a length of 3–30 seconds, an aspect ratio of 16:9, 9:16 or 1:1, and whether to include sound. Up to three subjects can appear in one shot, and a clip can be continued with the next shot. The default model is Kling 4, with options including Kling 3.0 Omni (lower cost) and several other models such as Seedance 2.5, Wan 3.0 and Vidu Q4 selectable in the studio. The page also lists ready-made ad formats and a Thanksgiving template.
notable: Reference-photo consistency for characters and products across many videos
Choice of 9 video models in one studio, with Kling 4 as default
Failed videos refunded automatically; credits reserved at start and charged only on completion
Prompts in other languages are translated for the model with subject names kept
caveats: Paid after the first free clip: single videos cost $2.99–$6.99, and subscriptions start at $10/month (listed as $8 on yearly billing)
Free account gets one short clip, which is 720p and silent on Kling 3.0 Omni (or 4 seconds with sound or at 1080p)
Real people: only photos of yourself or consenting people; celebrities and unpermitted depictions are not allowed
